lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate the life story of one car — a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX — over 17 years, like a short documentary with dry irony. Calm, warm, slightly nostalgic; numbers said fully. «Лансер Эволюшн» — Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution.

gosha.profile: Gosha — a young Russian amateur racer in his 20s in a red racing jacket and a white cap, excited, cocky.
gosha.notes: Line 1: proud, passionate about the car. Line 2: guilty, embarrassed, after crashing the car into a snowbank at night.

semen.profile: Semyonych — an old Russian garage mechanic in his 60s, mustache and glasses, honest, calm, a master restorer.
semen.notes: Line 1: proud, warm, about restoring the car for three winters. Line 2: honest, firm, a bit ashamed of his son; offers a fair price.

kirill.profile: Kirill — Semyonych's son in his 20s, a slick seller who exaggerates.
kirill.notes: One line: overconfident sales pitch, lying that the car was never crashed.

dima.profile: Dima — a calm, smart Russian car buyer in his 30s, rally fan.
dima.notes: Line 1: ironic question, then a calm fact. Line 2: short, satisfied agreement.
